items.text: "Based on the scope of the role and the value I expect to contribute, I was hoping we could discuss".

items.heading: "Thank You for the Offer
items.text: "Thank you for the offer. I am excited about the role. Before I confirm, I wanted to discuss compensation. Based on the scope, the responsibilities, and the market for this kind of work, I was hoping we could explore a number closer to [target].".

items.heading: Negotiating Without Preparation
items.text: Negotiating without preparation. If you do not know your range, alternatives, or proof, you are reacting instead of steering.

items.heading: Talking Too Much After
items.text: Talking too much after the ask. Many people weaken the number by immediately justifying it nervously.

items.heading: Bluffing with Offers You Do
items.text: Bluffing with offers you do not have. Credibility is expensive to lose.
